keyPillars.insight: HTTPS .well-known/agent.json manifests served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * allow browsers to verify peer nodes directly without backend proxies.
W3C DID identifiers paired with SHA-256 Merkle proofs make every multi-agent execution independently auditable offline.
Explicit per-capability permission gates prevent unauthorized DOM inspection or network egress inside browser sandboxes.
